findings_fixed.detail: Metric variant=card now owns direct .mg-metric-icon and .mg-metric-body wrappers; Personal callers pass the icon node itself, so no nested primitive wrapper remains.
The no-session permission fallback passes action={null}, suppressing SurfaceState's default login CTA while leaving other permission callers unchanged.

unverified_items: Browser, responsive, assistive-technology, runtime API, deployment, and release verification were not run in this source-level remediation lane.
Concurrent changes outside the declared exclusive scope were not revalidated by this lane.
failure_origin: The visual mainline migration connected Personal metric callers to shared Metric markup without matching the card wrapper contract, and routed the no-session state through a permission primitive whose default CTA changed prior behavior.
